content: उदासीन {%<ab>pres. p.</ab>%} .²1 Indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic, passive; उदासीनवदासीनम् <ls>Bg. 9. 9</ls>. तद्दर्शिनमुदासीनं त्वामेव पुरुषं विदुः <ls>Ku. 2. 13</ls>. (taking no part in the creation of the material universe); see साङ्ख्य; <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 (In law) Not involved in any dispute. .²3 Neutral (as a king or nation). .{@-नः@} .²1 A stranger. .²2 A neutral, an indifferent person; अरिमित्रोदासीनव्यवस्था <ls>Mu. 5</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 158</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 345</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 9</ls>. .²3 A common acquaintance.
